parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotating fan blade assembly of the cooling fan, made of ABS plastic. It consists of multiple blades attached to a central hub.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to generate airflow, cooling electronic components or circulating air through a system.
parts.Movement_description: This part rotates around its central axis when powered by the motor, converting electrical energy into mechanical airflow.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the outer frame or housing of the fan, made of ABS plastic. It provides structural support and mounting points.
parts.Functional_description: The base body holds the fan blades and motor in place, ensuring stability and proper alignment during operation.
parts.Movement_description: This part remains stationary and does not move during operation, serving as the fixed support structure for the rotating fan.
